title: 883. Surface Area of 3D Shapes

examples.explanation: Sum of lone-tower areas minus shared sides gives 34.
Ring of eight cubes around a hole shows 32 faces.
Border towers of height 2 plus centre of height 1 total 46.

hints: A lone tower of height v shows 4*v+2 faces when v is positive and 0 otherwise.
Each pair of side-adjacent cells hides 2*min(v1,v2) faces; count each pair once by looking only right and down.
